title: The Secret History
summary:
This story, set in a small, elite college in Vermont, follows Richard Papen, a young student who becomes entangled with a group of eccentric and intellectually gifted classmates studying under the enigmatic Classics professor, Julian Morrow.

As Richard becomes increasingly drawn into the inner circle of his classmates—Henry, Bunny, Camilla, Charles, and Francis—he discovers that they are engaged in a secret and morally dubious study of ancient Greek philosophy and rituals. Bound by loyalty and a sense of intellectual superiority, the group delves deeper into their studies, leading to increasingly dangerous and disturbing consequences.

As tensions within the group escalate and their actions spiral out of control, Richard finds himself torn between his loyalty to his friends and his growing sense of guilt and unease. The novel explores themes of friendship, morality, identity, and the consequences of obsession as Richard grapples with the dark secrets and hidden agendas of his classmates.

pieces.about: Rome is the capital city of Italy. It is also the capital of the Lazio region, the centre of the Metropolitan City of Rome Capital, and a special comune (municipality) named Comune di Roma Capitale. With 2,860,009 residents in 1,285 km2 (496.1 sq mi), Rome is the country's most populated comune and the third most populous city in the European Union by population within city limits. The Metropolitan City of Rome, with a population of 4,355,725 residents, is the most populous metropolitan city in Italy. Its metropolitan area is the third-most populous within Italy. Rome is located in the central-western portion of the Italian Peninsula, within Lazio (Latium), along the shores of the Tiber. Vatican City is an independent country inside the city boundaries of Rome, the only existing example of a country within a city. Rome is often referred to as the City of Seven Hills due to its geographic location, and also as the "Eternal City". Rome is generally considered to be the cradle of Western civilization and Western Christian culture, and the centre of the Catholic Church.

pieces.about: Greek is an independent branch of the Indo-European family of languages, native to Greece, Cyprus, Italy, southern Albania, and other regions of the Balkans, the Black Sea coast, Asia Minor, and the Eastern Mediterranean. It has the longest documented history of any Indo-European language, spanning at least 3,400 years of written records. Its writing system is the Greek alphabet, which has been used for approximately 2,800 years; previously, Greek was recorded in writing systems such as Linear B and the Cypriot syllabary. The alphabet arose from the Phoenician script and was in turn the basis of the Latin, Cyrillic, Coptic, Gothic, and many other writing systems.

pieces.name: Peer Pressure
pieces.sentence: Richard bends himself to fit a group he admires, and the group's pressure leads each member toward choices none of them would make alone. A reader can see how belonging can cost a person their own judgment.

pieces.name: Moral Standards
pieces.sentence: Julian's circle treats its own tastes as above ordinary rules, and the story follows what that costs. A reader can think about where their own lines are, and what keeps them there.

pieces.name: Decision Making
pieces.sentence: Several turning points come from a single decision made under pressure and without enough thought. A reader can notice how pressure narrows choices and ask what they would want to have decided.

pieces.name: Trust and Friendship
pieces.sentence: The six are close, and yet one friend becomes a danger to the others and the group turns on him. A reader can think about loyalty, honesty and what a friend owes to a friend.

pieces.name: Self Worth
pieces.sentence: Richard hides his working-class background because he feels he does not belong, and he trades honesty for acceptance. A reader can think about being valued for who they really are.
